title: Protection-Bundle Multiplier on the Replacement System Installations Accessory Member Discount
content:
# Protection-bundle multiplier

## Rule

The protection-bundle factor of the accessory member discount on a Replacement System Installations contract follows the labor-warranty upgrade charged on the same contract:

- an upgrade to the Harbison 12-Year Total Protection or the Harbison 12-Year Total Protection Plus multiplies the discount by 1.4;
- an upgrade to any other protection tier multiplies it by 1.2;
- a contract with no upgrade keeps 1.0.

The upgrade is read from the labor-warranty upgrade charge on the project ledger, which names the protection tier bought.

## Grid

| Labor-warranty upgrade charged on the contract | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| Harbison 12-Year Total Protection | 1.4 |
| Harbison 12-Year Total Protection Plus | 1.4 |
| Harbison 5-Year Labor Protection, Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection or Harbison 10-Year Parts & Labor Protection | 1.2 |
| None | 1.0 |

## Cases (hypothetical contracts)

- A Harbison Advantage Series System contract with an upgrade to the Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection: 1.2.
- A Harbison Signature Elite Communicating System contract with an upgrade to the Harbison 12-Year Total Protection Plus: 1.4.
- A contract whose package includes a protection tier and carries no upgrade charge: 1.0 — the included tier is not an upgrade charge.
